Turn aligned initiative context into an actionable roadmap scope.

## Tasks
- Read `.stage/ROADMAP-XXX/issue-summary.md` and `.stage/ROADMAP-XXX/community-alignment.md`.
- Define in-scope and out-of-scope items.
- Slice in-scope work into vertical tasks that can run in parallel.
- For each task include: objective, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and owner suggestions.
- Save draft scope and tasks to `.stage/ROADMAP-XXX/roadmap.md`.
- Ask for user approval before proceeding.

## Rules
- Keep tasks independently deliverable whenever possible.
- Prefer small task slices over broad multi-component items.
